geeklist.title: Strategy and Tactics Wargames with Magazines - all in excellent condition - most unpunched
geeklist.description: Strategy and Tactics Wargames with Magazines - all in excellent condition - most unpunched Raitonalising our personal collection and selling off the duplicates = a great way to buy a cheap excellent wargame and a high quality magazine. All starting bids start at $10 .. shipping should be about $8 / $10 for one and $2 / $3 more for additional magazines/games. Shipped as stored in individual Letter size Ziplock bages - pet free and smoke free enviroment

UNPUNCHED Strategy and Tactics Issue #109 with Target Libya - It depicts a hypothetical US campaign against the Libyan regime, in retaliation for repeated terrorist attacks on US interests, believed to be supported by Qaddafi's government. The objective of the game for the US player is to eliminate Libyan key political units and seize strategic objectives, while limiting US losses.
SB $10

UNPUNCHED Strategy and Tactics Issue #110 - Hastings 1066 -tactical simulation of the confrontation between William the Bastard, Duke of Normandy, and King Harold Godwineson of Wessex... a battle that forever changed the face of the world, as the victor became King. $12 SB $12

item.objectname: Napoleon and the Archduke Charles: The Battle of Abensberg
item.body: UNPUNCHED Strategy and Tactics Issue #113 Napoleon and the Archduke Charles , The Battle of Abensburg - Abensberg is a complete game in itself. It can also be played as a “campaign game” linked with another of Bonaparte series, The Battle of Eckmuhl plus Iran / Iraq war articles SB $12

UNPUNCHED Strategy and Tactics Issue #137 - Men at Arms , tactical combat 1200BC - 1500AD - huge scope with a tactical game system for pre-gunpowder battles, spanning ancient and medieval times. SB $10
UNPUNCHED Strategy and Tactics Issue #141 - Hannibal : The Second Punic War - covers the conflict between Carthage and Rome, during the period of 218 to 195 BC - wide ranging $12

UNPUNCHED Strategy and Tactics Issue #142 - Tarawa Red Beach One - A solitaire game of the amphibious assault on Betio Island by the U.S. 2nd Marine Division on November 20, 1943. Marine corps articles inc $14
UNPUNCHED Strategy and Tactics Issue #118 - The Tigers are burning - Campaigns for the Ukraine, 1943-44 is a strategic level simulation of the Soviet reconquest of that vital area. $12

UNPUNCHED Strategy and Tactics Issue #126 - Beriut '82 Arab Stalingrad simulates the siege of Beirut, and its victory conditions recreate the diplomatic hindrances of that struggle. One side plays the PLO, Syrians, Amal, Druse and SPP. The other side played is the IDF & their Phalangist Allies. $12

UNPUNCHED Strategy and Tactics Issue #146 - The Italian Campaign Series: Sicily, is the first of four operational level games (Sicily, Salerno, Anzio and Med War) simulating the Battle for Italy in World War II using the Westwar Gaming System developed by Vanguard Games. This game represents the Allied invasion of Sicily - excellent game - $13

item.objectname: Combined Arms: Combat Operations in the 20th Century
item.body: PUNCHED BUT VERFIED COMPLETE AND IN MINT CONDITION Strategy and Tactics Issue #46 - Combined Arms - tactical game that simulates modern warfare from the German Invasion of Poland in 1939 to the Yom Kippur War of 1973. The correct and proper interrelationship of the three basic combat arms; armor, infantry and artillery are explored. Magazine in VGC $15

item.objectname: Sixth Fleet: US/Soviet Naval Operations in the Mediterranean in the 1970's
item.body: PUNCHED BUT VERFIED COMPLETE AND IN MINT CONDITION Strategy and Tactics Issue #38 - Sixth Fleet - US/Soviet Naval Warfare in the Mediterranean in the 1970's, is a simulation of operational naval warfare in the Mediterranean based on a hypothetical war between the Soviet Union and the NATO Alliance during the 1970's. Also released as a flat pack - very economic way to buy this classic game. - $22

PUNCHED BUT VERFIED COMPLETE AND IN MINT CONDITION Strategy and Tactics Issue #39 - The Fall of Rome - Strategic level Solitaire board-wargame of the Barbarian invasion of Rome, with the player controlling the Roman forces. $20

item.objectname: Baton Rouge: Street Fighting in the Louisiana Capital, August 5, 1862
item.body: PUNCHED BUT VERFIED COMPLETE AND IN MINT CONDITION Strategy and Tactics Issue #133 Baton Rouge from famed designer Richard Berg - Baton Rouge is part of the Great Battles of the American Civil War series (GBACW). This series is an offshoot of the Terrible Swift Sword: Battle of Gettysburg Game (TSS) system. Great opportunity to own this 'must have ' - $25
